storyTitle: Verify Statement Credit Value & Goal Progress
oneSentenceStory: Customer quickly reviews statement credit value and tracks progress toward their holiday spending goal with complete transparency.
customerSituation: Customer opens the mobile rewards overview to check accumulated LBG coins and evaluate progress toward their holiday savings goal.
storyTension: Ensuring earned rewards translate directly to predictable, guaranteed bill reductions without hidden conditions or gamified distractions.
customerResolution: Clear visibility into tangible statement credit value and goal milestones confirms steady progress.
primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of statement credit value and savings goal progress.
prohibitedDetours: Promoting experience vouchers or non-statement rewards
completionSignals: User checks holiday goal progress component
